behavior: Calling any of java_hover, java_definition or java_references with a `path` that does not resolve to any known workspace root always produces a structured error explicitly naming the unroutable case -- never a successful result, and never a successful empty result standing in for 'no workspace found'.
rationale: Requires a real project-router decision against a real unroutable path -- the matrix's integration/e2e_scenario technique, and this feature's own falsifier explicitly names the unroutable sweep case [INV-TOOL-4]. Falsifies an unroutable path silently returning `[]`/`null`/an empty success instead of a structured error naming which failure case it is -- the exact failure X-003's closed taxonomy and this feature's falsifier both forbid.
